official_description:
The Nord Triple Pedal 2 enhances your Nord keyboard with unparalleled control and realism. It features continuous sensors on all three pedals, enabling half-pedaling techniques for nuanced sustain effects. This allows for subtle variations in the sustain level, providing a more expressive and natural playing experience. 

In addition to its continuous sensors, the Triple Pedal 2 incorporates Dynamic Pedal Noise, which emulates the mechanical sounds of an acoustic piano pedal. This subtle yet impactful feature adds another layer of authenticity to your performance, making it feel even more connected to the instrument.
